To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
training is the strongest predictor of employees' perception of and usage of technological innovation.

employees' favorable attitudes towards an innovation is a strong determinant of its adoption in workplace settings and training and education are the key factors in influencing employees' favorable attitude.
employees' favorable attitudes toward an innovation are translated into its adoption at the workplace, but only when employees are trained and have a certain level of education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of demographic variables on the perception and adoption of an innovation in the workplace context.
the demographic determinants of adoption of technological innovation.
the demographic factors that affect an individual's adoption of innovation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the demographic variables of education and training are important predictors of an individual’s attitude towards innovation.
demographic characteristics of employees are significant predictors of the perception and acceptance of an innovation at workplace.
the demographic characteristics of the employees have a significant impact on the acceptance and use of technological innovation in the workplace.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
training and education of employees can help in creating a positive attitude towards technological innovations and this can be translated into its acceptance in the workplace.
the demographics of employees are important factors in the adoption of technological innovation.
demographic factors do not play a significant role in determining the perception of an innovation but they do play a role in the adoption of an innovation in workplaces.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a favorable attitude towards an innovative technology is not sufficient for the successful implementation of the technology in a workplace.
training is an important factor that can help in getting an innovation adopted in the workplace.
organizations can improve the acceptance and use of innovation by providing training to employees.
